statement: Every outflow of a debtor's reserve enforces its debt queue first, oldest first and at most 32 claims per call, and what is spendable is the reserve less all outstanding debt; a part-paid claim stays at the head. The calls that enforce are the permissionless enforceDebts, and inside a batch a reserve-to-external-token transfer, a reserve-to-reserve transfer, a reserve-to-collateral deposit, a settlement outflow and a dispute payout. The Arrival pages hold the reserve-to-collateral deposit (J page: cap, oldest first, part-paid stays at the head) and the dispute payout (dispute page, one older-debt amount per side in both directions: enforcement before payment, the per-call cap, the peer paid all of the spendable reserve it can); the other calls are the contract's and no layer here kills them yet.
